class.name: PhysicsServer3DExtension
class.brief_description: Provides virtual methods that can be overridden to create custom [PhysicsServer3D] implementations.
class.description: This class extends [PhysicsServer3D] by providing additional virtual methods that can be overridden. When these methods are overridden, they will be called instead of the internal methods of the physics server. Intended for use with GDExtension to create custom implementations of [PhysicsServer3D].

method.name: _body_get_user_flags
method.description: Returns the internal user flags stored for [param body]. Native backend hook; this operation is not bound on the public PhysicsServer3D interface.

method.name: _body_set_user_flags
method.description: Stores the internal [param flags] for [param body]. Native backend hook; this operation is not bound on the public PhysicsServer3D interface.

method.name: _end_sync
method.description: Called to indicate that the physics server has stopped synchronizing. It is in the loop's iteration/physics phase, and can access physics objects even if running on a separate thread. See also [method _sync]. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code]end_sync[/code] method.

method.name: _finish
method.description: Called when the main loop finalizes to shut down the physics server. See also [method MainLoop._finalize] and [method _init]. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code]finish[/code] method.

method.name: _flush_queries
method.description: Called every physics step before [method _step] to process all remaining queries. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code]flush_queries[/code] method.

method.name: _init
method.description: Called when the main loop is initialized and creates a new instance of this physics server. See also [method MainLoop._initialize] and [method _finish]. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code]init[/code] method.

method.name: _is_flushing_queries
method.description: Overridable method that should return [code]true[/code] when the physics server is processing queries. See also [method _flush_queries]. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code]is_flushing_queries[/code] method.

method.name: _joint_get_configuration
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.joint_get_configuration]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _joint_get_constraint_force
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.joint_get_constraint_force]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _joint_get_constraint_torque
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.joint_get_constraint_torque]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _joint_make_configured
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.joint_make_configured]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _joint_make_hinge_simple
method.description: Creates a hinge on [param joint] using body-local pivot and axis pairs for bodies A and B. This internal native hook is an alternative to [method PhysicsServer3D.joint_make_hinge], which takes complete attachment transforms.

method.name: _joint_set_configuration
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.joint_set_configuration]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _space_apply_explosion
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.space_apply_explosion]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _space_get_contact_hit_events
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.space_get_contact_hit_events]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _space_get_joint_events
method.description: Overridable version of [method PhysicsServer3D.space_get_joint_events]. Required when implementing a custom physics server; preserve the public method's validation, return values, and event schema.

method.name: _step
method.description: Called every physics step to process the physics simulation. [param step] is the time elapsed since the last physics step, in seconds. It is usually the same as the value returned by [method Node.get_physics_process_delta_time]. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code skip-lint]step[/code] method.

method.name: _sync
method.description: Called to indicate that the physics server is synchronizing and cannot access physics states if running on a separate thread. See also [method _end_sync]. Overridable version of [PhysicsServer3D]'s internal [code]sync[/code] method.

method.name: body_test_motion_is_excluding_body
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the body with the given [RID] is being excluded from [method _body_test_motion]. See also [method Object.get_instance_id].

method.name: body_test_motion_is_excluding_object
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if the object with the given instance ID is being excluded from [method _body_test_motion]. See also [method Object.get_instance_id].
